reviews.text: Very good staff, friendly and welcoming! Recommend the vets, had a great experience!
Thanks so much, Gladys! We’re always happy to see Tabachi and really appreciate your review.
Amazing friendly service, managed to fit us in within 30 minutes without a booking. Thank you, and best consultation price in the area
Great service and felt very taken care of. Highly recommend!

Blaise, one of the nurses, was really lovely with Winnie🐶. She’s incredibly attentive, always happy to help, and genuinely keeps an eye on how dogs are doing. The place is lovely too, and the whole team is on top of everything. Such a great experience!!! …
New vet, just moved to the area. Lovely staff and great pet care. No complaints.

I’ve just registered with this veterinary clinic and I’m already so impressed. The team is incredibly welcoming, professional and clearly very knowledgeable. Their prices are also very reasonable, and it’s reassuring to know they provide an emergency service when needed. The lovely welcome package was such a thoughtful touch too! I feel confident that my puppy will be in excellent hands and would highly recommend this clinic.
Thanks so much, Ed and Fiona. We really appreciate this. It was lovely to meet you with Murphy and we look forward to seeing you again soon!
A great young and knowledgeable team!
Imre and the team were great on my visit today, would recommend

Imre was amazing he was very thorough he really took his time and listened to all my concerns.  I can’t recommend him enough truly an amazing vet , I travelled very far just to be seen by him and he was truly worth the visit , absolutely amazing service !!!

Imre was outstanding, his level of knowledge and skill was amazing he was truly outstanding, he was really attentive to our worries and thoroughly checked our dog , very happy with our service, thank you so much Imre
The staff including the vets and especially the receptionist is professional and very kind.i would trust bringing your pet here and also if you need advice on anything.
Wonderful vets, and a fantastic team. Dr. Imre was amazing!
Such a lovely environment and the staff are so friendly and professional. They really make every visit feel like my dog is getting the princess treatment.
Help my pup w anal gland swelling.

I joined Creature Comforts a year ago and for private reason regretfully I had to leave them. Last Monday I decided to rejoin because I care for my dog and find the practice very professional, the staff are friendly and my dog feels comfortable going there. I highly recommend them.

Honestly one of the best vets I’ve been too. From the moment you walk in the door you are greeted and pet too with a big smile and they always remember your name too. My girls are very spoiled when they come to see them with lots of treats. They aren’t nervous at all and being cats they really can be. Always a joy coming to see them and you can see they all love animals too

We were having a challenging time transitioning my puppy from America to the UK and the team were able to take us same day at 6:30 PM with Dr Imre (although we were slightly late because of issues with our puppy, but thankfully they still accepted us!)

Upon arrival, the facilities were extremely modern and aesthetic catering to both canines and felines! There were treats and toys available as well

Dr Imre was FANTASTIC. We have been worried about my puppy’s behavior and he was extremely methodical and empathetic in his assessment and plan. We truly haven’t felt this comfortable and reassured especially when it came to our puppy exhibiting more aggressive behavior than usual. We look forward to continuing our care with the team in Chelsea!
Please don’t not use this vet, they are not trained professional, and they make you pay extra charge
Amazing experience, the staff were incredibly caring and knowledgeable, Teddy was super happy and very much in his happy place I.e lot a of treats, he is a very happy boy! Highly recommend!
Worst experience ever, no check at all before giving my cat medicine, my cat poo blood after taking that medicine. Bad rude attitudes after the wrong treatment. Don't go.
Kinga  was wonderful !! Highly reccomend
Amazing place and very lovely team

Creature Comforts delivered an outstanding experience from start to finish. Service was excellent throughout, with staff who were attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful at every step of the process. The interior was impeccably clean and thoughtfully designed, creating a welcoming and polished environment that immediately set the tone for a positive visit.

The overall process was remarkably smooth and easy, with no unnecessary friction or delays — everything felt efficient and well-organized. An especially pleasant surprise was the number of complimentary items included, adding genuine value to the experience and reflecting real generosity and attention to customer satisfaction.

Creature Comforts sets a high standard across the board, combining excellent service, thoughtful design, and unexpected extras into a thoroughly five-star experience.

Our dog received very caring and thoughtful care at Creatures Comforts! The veterinarians  listened attentively and offered several options of care. As our dog had eaten about 25 grapes, some care was needed immediately. We called the emergency line before arrival. The vets had everything ready and waiting. The office is impeccably clean and well organized, and the staff and veterinarians are top notch! We have been happy members of their services for 2 years. We initially visited the office in St John’s Woods, but moved across town. Switching clinics was effortless. I high recommend Creature Comforts in both locations!
Love how attentive they are! And how they can  update you by sending photos! Peace of mind ♥️

Poor communication and disappointing experience.

We took our Shiba Inu here for a consultation, during which her history of struvite crystals were mentioned several times. The vet recommended that we provide a urine sample for testing.

We delivered the sample as requested, but a few days later, when discussing the results, we were told that they had not actually carried out the struvite crystal test. Instead, they had performed a standard urine test, which came back “negative”... although it was not made clear what it was negative for.

We are now being asked to provide another urine sample and pay an additional £80 for the test we believed was being done in the first place. This has been frustrating, especially as our dog is still uncomfortable and suffering. The whole thing feels like a veterinary practice run by some PE firm trying to squeeze out money. Would not recommend!

Winnie really likes her visits as the staff are really nice and she gets yummy treats
I can call or go online and can get an appointment to put my mind at rest
The staff are so helpful and put me at ease all my visits have been check ups but I know if there were to be anything wrong with winnie I would know she is in good hands
They are so nice and you are made to feel welcome

I love this vet! I just moved abroad and was so nervous to find a new place to bring my cat because she’s definitely really shy and nervous. The team at Creature Comforts was so amazing and made her feel so comfortable from start to finish!
Felt very cared for and supported! Clean, fresh, thoughtful and intentional vet and staff. Really loved our experience here! They always are so attentive and helpful with my dog!

I visited Creature Comforts today with my dog Leo and was very disappointed with the experience. The vet was unprofessional and dismissive throughout the appointment. When attempting to take his temperature, she was unable to complete the task on two occasions due to his coat and he was visibly distressed and whimpering in pain during the process.

Most concerning was her refusal to prescribe antibiotics despite Leo having the exact same condition last year when antibiotics were successfully administered. She insisted on waiting three days for stool samples instead, which would unnecessarily prolong his suffering when I knew the appropriate treatment. When I questioned her suggestion for an IV drip purely for rehydration—which he didn’t need since she’d just confirmed he wasn’t dehydrated—she became evasive and offered vague responses.

Throughout the appointment, she spoke down to me,, and was dismissive when saying goodbye. This combination of inexperience, poor communication, and lack of willingness to listen to the patient’s owner left me with serious concerns about her care. I will not be returning.”
Outstanding! Dr Imy amazing 🤩 …

We brought in Baba G for the first visit.
What a great experience.
Dr Imi was absolutely brilliant he had an holistic approach which we found very helpful and interesting the first time a vet has ever looked at any dog of ours as a whole.Not pushing treatments,actually saving us money by suggesting a change in diet to address allergies and not continue with his normal expensive injections for now.
Thank you so much all staff were lovely too.

This place is amazing
Caring people, incredible compassion, and a clean, pretty setting. Highly recommended.

I’ve had better experiences with vets not afraid of dogs and their sensitivity… he almost asked me to put the headgear myself on my pet.. I come to the vet because they are experienced and can do it when I can’t!! I wouldn’t come if I could do it myself then instead of really trying- he proceeded to want to charge me 400 pounds for sedation. Every other vet I’ve been to has been able to get my dogs ears cleaned with simply gabapentin and trazadone. Don’t come here if u have sensitive pets . their main vet here is too scared and didint provide much help. Much stronger vets elsewhere in the area!
Very friendly and professional staff, Lucky had a great visit
Professional, thorough and because the vets are permanent you get to see the same one, not a locum, so they know your pet and its history. Couldn’t be more satisfied!
The best for both humans and fur babies.
They are amazing.  Thank you so much for looking after coco. Please give them all recognition for such attentive service and support.

Amazing service!
All the staff are so nice, lovely and helpful.
I do definitely recommend this clinic as they handled my kitten with care and I’m so happy I signed up!! 😊 …

It's one of the best medical clinics I've ever visited, which is why I became a member. When I enter the clinic, I feel very comfortable. The entire team is characterized by their excellent treatment, patience, outstanding performance, and speed of service, making you proud of this team.

The vets at Creature Comforts take such good care of our cats. It’s lovely getting to see the same vets each time so they can build a medical history and can see the cats grow and progress throughout their lives. Top notch service from front of house staff, friendly and calming atmosphere and a very clean space.

Couldn't be happier with the care my dog received here.the team was incredibly friendly patient and attentive.ive been to few other places over the past 20 years of having pets but this definitely took my experience to another level.

This is a veterinary clinic like no other. I've never had such a positive experience with a vet. Everyone is so kind and genuinely interested in you and your fur baby. Ralph went to a few different vets before I found Creature Comforts and the way they treated him before with his FIV made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. The team at Creature Comforts have shown nothing but love, affection and care for Ralph which is exactly what any owner would want. I can see how comfortable Ralph is in their hands as well. Thank you everyone 💜

I recently got a puppy and visited quite a few vet clinics in the area before choosing this one - and I’m so glad I did! Melis from the membership team was absolutely amazing and so helpful in answering all my questions, which really made me feel confident and comfortable moving forward with them.

Their offering and pricing are fantastic, especially for a first-time puppy owner like me. Booking appointments is super easy, and everyone at the Chelsea branch has been genuinely lovely and welcoming.

Overall, I couldn’t be happier with my choice!

Excellent.  I am very impressed with the head vet at the Chelsea branch, the quality of the facilities and the fact that my monthly membership covers consultations in any London branch and vaccines .  The staff are all lovely. Highly recommend

5 Stars just isn’t enough.  It’s an absolute joy to be a part of this Veterinary Practice & the whole set up from Customer Service, the staff, the app are all in a different league of their own.  Dr Imre is a class act, such a gentleman & is so so good with my pets.
Thank you all so much.  100% it is a pet community.

Dr Imre is one of the best vets we’ve ever seen, I would highly recommend him for anything with cats. The clinic is nice and clean, and Hannah at reception is friendly and efficient. Good communication from Damian also regarding a separate issue.
It was a real pleasure to meet the friendly staff today, at Creature Comforts. Lottie, our daschund, was given excellent VIP treatment and she fully appreciated all those  treats
Couldn’t recommend more! Everyone there is so lovely and welcoming, and they’re always amazing with Winnie. It’s such a nice feeling knowing she’s in such good hands 💖 …

We joined Creature Comfort last year after bumping into one of their representatives in Battersea Park! Seriously, the best decision ever! They are so kind and welcoming, the service they provide is personal, warm and professional! Our dog Noodle absolutely loves going there! It’s like a treat for her.

Hannan, Abby the practice hosts are always so happy when we bring Noodle in. They give Noodle the best cuddles and the attention!
They make Noodle feel like a celebrity!

Dr Hattie and Dr Imre are so kind and professional, as a first time dog mum, we cannot be happier, the care level and professional advice we get from them is amazing!

We also love their transparency on pricing and makes dog care extra easy to manage!

Highly recommend!!

I’m so grateful for the care we received for our angel Yogi. Dr Imre at the Chelsea branch was exceptional, he took the time to listen carefully to my dog’s full history and quickly identified the cause of the vomiting. His approach to treatment was thoughtful and precise, and thanks to him, Yogi recovered well.

What I appreciated most was how clearly he explained everything, especially the blood test results. He also walked me through the different treatment options depending on how my dog responded, which made me feel informed and reassured throughout the process.

The clinic itself is beautifully designed, and the whole team is warm and welcoming. I had been going to another vet before, but after experiencing how easy it is to book appointments and use their app, I feel so relieved to have found a place I truly trust. Not only is the service outstanding, but the environment is also lovely. Highly recommend. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Outstanding service, phenomenal care, the staff and doctors always take time to care for the pets and explain everything to my family
Amazing local independent vet with superb staff. Can highly recommend!
Our procedure went really well, they took good care of my kitten, the staff of the clinic  is always very friendly. Highly recommended this vet clinic. We will come back again 🐾 …

I took out a subscription with Creature Comforts about two months ago but had t really used it yet. My dog is 13 and had been very healthy. She also is very wary of strangers and is petrified of vets. Last week a major health problem arose so I had my first need to really use them. I have to say I was really impressed with how kind and caring everyone was. This is the third vet practice I’ve used but it’s the first where I felt the staff and in particular the vet himself was really sympathetic and supportive to me and my dog. The others were competent but not particularly compassionate.

We had a lovely visit to Creature Comforts yesterday with our new puppy for an initial check. The team were so welcoming and all came out to say hello to Toots and give her a cuddle. We were spoilt with treats and left with some complimentary puppy food too. We joined the All Access membership which is fantastic as means we can go for monthly check-ups while Toots is growing, plus she loved the team so much I’m sure we’ll be popping in every now and then just to say hello! I had a tour of the facilities which were state of the art and very carefully thought through, including quiet waiting rooms for cats. Onsite dentistry, X-rays, surgical facilities. Plus I love the app, 24-hour chat service and ability to schedule appointments directly at short notice. I feel very secure that Toots will be well cared for.
Such a lovely experience at Creature Comforts Chelsea! The whole team was so kind and welcoming. Baguette loved it there

Thank you so much to the entire clinic team for taking care of my little dog during his emergency. We are deeply grateful not only for the way you treated him, but also for the way you cared about us during such a sad and distressing moment.
Thank you for keeping us informed at every step , from  how he was doing, how the procedure was going, and what to expect. It was a very difficult experience for us, and you handled everything with such professionalism, kindness, and empathy.
We truly appreciate everything you did. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
I had an excellent experience with this veterinary clinic. The team is incredibly professional, caring, and attentive to both pets and their owners.
Really friendly and knowledgable vets. Highly recommended.
Fantastic vet clinic 🥰 very caring made my baby 🐶 very loved & myself extremely at ease. Will recommend 💯% …

We chose this clinic largely because of its warm atmosphere and the many reviews describing it as having a “home-like” and caring approach. Our initial impression was indeed very positive.

However, in our situation, it felt that the approach was primarily based on standard protocols, without sufficient consideration of our dog’s individual circumstances. We had expected a more personalised discussion of potential risks and possible consequences, including those relating to insurance coverage.

Following the consultation and the medical documentation provided, our insurance company reviewed our policy and excluded coverage related to the upcoming surgery. As a result, we are now required to proceed without insurance support.

The clinic maintains that all actions were carried out in accordance with procedures. From our perspective, however, we were left with the feeling that our concerns and the longer-term implications were not fully taken into account.

I would recommend that pet owners carefully discuss how medical records may affect their insurance policies and ensure they fully understand all potential consequences before proceeding.
Excellent expertise, welcoming and caring people. Generous membership. Premises very nicely kept. Highly recommend.

Our rescue cat was treated so well and kept calm. He hid in the sink mostly during his assessment.
All the vets and staff are really nice, friendly and reassuring. We highly recommend them.

Great experience, really lovely folks who are welcoming and just make you feel at home. We had our family dog vaccinated, and from start to finish it was really nice. There are free treats (for both pets *and* humans!) and the treatment was super smooth — our dog didn't even realize what was happening and it was all sorted and we were out of there. Shout out to Camilly and Dr. Imre for providing us with a warm, welcoming experience.

Booked an appointment for my dog in the Chelsea Branch and was told to pay the full cost of the appointment in advance. It would have been my first time on this clinic. They have been pestering me with offers to join their services so I thought I would give it a try.
My dog is a patient at Goddard Fulham and Wagyn Tales in Fulham and in 7 years never have I been asked to pay in advance. Just cancelled the appointment and booked with Wolfe Vets for the first time (because is Saturday afternoon and his usual vets noted above are closed). The person from Creature Comfort who booked the appointment tried to convince me is quite common and others Vets also charge in advance. I will pay £5 more on the consultation with Wolfe Vets out of principle as they have not asked me to pay in advance. I could have been more understanding if I was asked to pay a small booking fee to confirm the appointment and discounted after the appointment but to expect full payment in advance is not acceptable. How not to win a new customer.

Reply: Charging a small amount to secure the appointment and in the event of no show you can retain the deposit, but to charge a full consultation in advance is unacceptable.

This vet clinic is absolutely amazing! It’s super clean and really well taken care of. The atmosphere is so warm and welcoming—my dog used to be scared of the vet, but now he feels totally safe. Plus, the staff is super professional and just really kind. I couldn’t recommend them more! #Zora

This has been the best vet experience I have ever had. My dog recently gave birth to nine puppies, and my boyfriend and I had many concerns about their health. The team guided us through the birth with amazing phone consultations, responding immediately whenever we needed help.
Whenever I had a concern ( I’m a rather neurotic dog mum!), they answered every question, truly easing my anxiety. The care we, and the animals,  have received has been incredible. The team guinely care about the health of them all, going above and beyond to make sure they are healthy and happy.
Thanks to their support, our mumma dog is now back to being a healthy, nursing mum. I honestly couldn’t have managed this experience without the help of Creature Comforts and their amazing staff. Thank you so much!  I will be reccomending creature comforts, espeically this branch to every pet owner! Thank you team!!!

Lucas, Eve, Sam xx
So impressed. Professional, kind, easy to get into quickly, and even left with a thoughtful little gift bag. Very friendly and thorough care. Thank you.😊 …

today so angry why like this! The spay surgery was completed, but the lack of clear explanation about the surgical approach and the unexpectedly large incision on my 6-month-old kitten was very concerning. Better communication is needed.
Very good experience to do the rabies vaccination at creature comforts. The app is super convenient to use. [🐶Yummy treats! Got another lovely purple ball🎉] …
Registered with them today and they were fantastic. Very friendly, very helpful and able to answer all questions. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

I can’t speak highly enough of the staff at Creature Comforts Vets in Chelsea. The care and attention they gave to Pebble was second to none and it’s always a pleasure to pop in on our way past and say hi! Thank you for everything

We’ve been members for a few months now, the team is very warm and welcoming. Our Labrador is super excited to go into the vets because of all the love (and treats) he gets. We’ve recently done a dental clean with them as well, which went smoothly, we got frequent updates (incl photos) to see how he was settling in and know which stage the process was in. Overall highly recommend.

Thank you to the wonderful team in Chelsea for creating a warm, friendly environment full of love and care! Everybody here has been kind and professional from the start, keeping us well informed throughout procedures via the app. Our dogs Uly and Cali finally feel at ease, knowing that visiting the vet doesn’t have to be daunting. Thank you! 💜🐾
Excellent level of care and all the team are lovely and so helpful, I highly recommend !!!
Creature comforts are amazing, they are so caring and treat your dog like it’s their own each time. Highly recommend!
Nice experience, lovely staff and nice modern facilities
Thank you for looking after Prim for her dental procedure 🪥😸 …
What a great addition to the neighbourhood! Very thankful to have a veterinarian nearby whose team are so thoughtful and caring!
Absolutely beautiful clinic, super friendly and helpful staff 😊 …
Great practice, lovely staff and my dog loves the free treats and balls
Very friendly staff, my puppy felt very comfortable and was very happy.
The staff here are what make the clinic so wonderful. ⭐️ thank you so much.

We have been a member of creature comforts since we got our pup 5 months ago and have always received outstanding service. We had the first proper illness with our pup last week, and we were once again incredibly impressed. They were quick to act, very thorough and gave us clear explanation and advice. They were also so kind and compassionate to our pup, and us. We felt really confident that she was receiving amazing care. We are incredibly grateful and want to give a very special thanks to Cat and Damian for all they have done the last few days.

In our experience everyone that works there is so warm and friendly and exceptional at what they do, would 100% recommend!

Excellent vet who kept Bonnie safe.
Excellent service.
My Labrador loves coming here, he always get lots of treats and loves the free balls. The staff are all really welcoming and it’s always a great experience.

Super treatment for my puppy!!
Lots of treats and love for the little ones
Hattie is extremely caring and knowledgeable, Creature Comforts Chelsea are a great team

Delighted with the experience at Creature Comforts. The staff is very attentive and Hettie, the vet has spent quality time with us, discussing our case and plan for the year. My  Chihuahua was also very calm & at ease with the doctor & the staff. Thank you!
Always a warm and pleasant experience bringing my cat, Luna. The team genuinely cares about looking after the animals and treats them with so much kindness and compassion. Highly recommend!
Such a great, friendly and professional practice. The dog actually gets excited to go there..!

Great new practice, staff were very welcoming and friendly, clean facilities and our Otis frenchie was welcomed with nice treats!
Highly recommend
Excellent service; excellent staff; my cat was really well looked after!!! Thank you!!!

I had a wonderful experience at this veterinary clinic with my cat, Teo. The environment is very calm and peaceful, and he felt completely at ease from the moment we arrived.

As this was his first visit to the vet and he was going to have a vaccination, I was feeling quite apprehensive. To my surprise, he absolutely loved being with the veterinarian and didn’t seem to feel the injection at all.

The clinic is beautiful, clean, and thoughtfully designed, with lots of toys and treats for pets. I truly loved the experience and I’m confident I made the right choice for Teo’s veterinary care.

The lovely team at Creature Comforts Chelsea were so kind and welcoming. They made Jasper feel right at home. I emailed them ahead of our appointment to make sure they had Jasper’s medication and they were very responsive and helpful. The space was very clean. From beginning to end we had the best experience. They even gave Jasper a welcome gift!
Very knowledgeable nurse. Recommend this place to all in the area with dogs and cats!

DR IMI was fantastic. He was very patient and caring towards my doggie and extremely knowledgeable when I had any questions. I didn’t feel rushed or unsure about any information provided. Dr Imi is highly recommended. Thanks to the lovely ladies at Reception who were also so welcoming.
They are the best !!!! My dog Rory loves everyone that works there xx
We received a very warm welcome and very professional care. I would highly recommend !

Cannot recommend Creature Comforts enough.  I used to frequent the branch in Notting Hill (also excellent) and have since chosen the Chelsea branch as it is closer to me.  The subscription model is a brilliant concept and the staff is always so friendly and helpful.  Dr Hattie, what a delight and even my normally unfriendly cat fell in love with her.  Thank you!

Nala had a great experience her first time at Creature Comforts. The receptionists were so helpful, warming and attentive, giving her treaties to make her feel comfortable. The nurse referred us to a vet the same day to help, and the vets care was exceptional! Nala has always felt anxious at the vets but at the end of the day she was so calm, and got a Polaroid on the Christmas tree!
I have been a member for nearly a year- The entire staff are so great with my dog. The office is so lovely and I always feel that my dog is being taken care of very well!

We had a great first visit at Creature Comforts Chelsea! My cat saw Dr. Hattie for a little skin issue and she was amazing at easing any nerves and getting right to the problem! Plus we got a bunch of goodies and Hattie was really clear about pricing before going forward. We will be back in a week for a check up and really looking forward to continuing working with Dr. Hattie and Creature Comforts!
Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, all around a great experience, can’t wait to come again!
Always the friendliest and most accommodating team, so happy to have my Darla in great hands 💞 …

Finally a space where pets are truly loved -- and medical care is word class. Miss Zooey loved Creature Comforts Vets Chelsea because the team greeted her with love. And she had access to the same vet for every visit. She also got a complete health check (a rare occurrence at other clinics) and the advice given was "health first" its approach instead of "for profit only". The brilliant team also handled her insurance and made sure her owner was taken care of too :). Forget all other vets, head to Creature Comforts only. And NO, this is NOT a sponsored post.

Had a recent appointment with Hattie and my 8 month old Labrador, Scrumpy. Hattie was brilliant, kind and patient and nothing was too much to ask (even a last minute nail clip)! The team was so welcoming and scrumpy loved every minute! He tries to drag me in whenever we walk past! Would fully recommend this practice to anyone!

Me and my puppy had an amazing first experience at this vets! They were all so accommodating and really made my anxious boy feel comfortable. I love that I knew exactly what to expect when speaking with the vet as she was not only completely upfront with costs and asked if it would be okay before proceeding she was also informative and answered any questions I had. Amazing team, stunning clinic, and great vet care! I really couldn’t be happier with my choice of choosing to stay on the all access membership, I highly recommend!

Not to mention the bag with all the little goodies in it was just so sweet! My pup loved everything in it that was for him, especially the treats and ball, he couldn’t get enough of it at home (^ω^)

We had an amazing experience at this new clinic in Chelsea. They welcomed Boss, our dachshund, as if he’d been coming there for years. The receptionist was incredibly warm and friendly, and the vet was informative, patient, and genuinely caring. Everything felt professional but relaxed, which instantly put us at ease. We even signed up for the membership on the spot because we felt confident Boss will be properly looked after here. Highly recommend!

My cavapoo puppy was very happy with his first checkup at Creature Comforts Vets in Chelsea. The team were very gentle and professional with him, which he enjoyed. He They have guided me through the puppy vaccination schedule, diet change and answered a thousand other questions that I had as a new puppy parent. All went super smooth and playful, and we left with a bag of toys, treats and a free vet food sample for my pet to try. The clinic itself is very bright, cool and newly refurbished place that makes pets feeling happy and comfortable. We will be visiting regularly!
Friendly staff who take initiative and put the customer and their pets at ease.

I recently joined Creature Comforts and have just taken my little Havanese for her annual check up and inoculations. The staff were so friendly and genuinely love animals. We were seen by a vet immediately, who was very professional, couldn't be happier with my choice.
Great staff/team and great support in a worrying time

My first appointment with my little Pomeranian Mr Darcy was an absolute joy! Dr Imre Pesta Berry was informative, helping me to create a new feeding regime for my fussy eater.  Darcy was calm and had a positive first experience which I can't thank the team for enough. The clinic is a beautiful space and we can't wait to go back.  They will assist me going forward to administer his worming treatment as I have found this difficult to do myself in the past.  We even got some fun toys and a lovely bandana complimentary. All round a 5 star practise with a friendly team who go out of their way to put you and your pet at ease.

Really impressed by this clinic, from the beautiful interiors to the lovely staff. My dog Milo is usually scared of vets, but here at Creature Comforts he was at complete ease and enjoyed all the attention. Would definitely recommend to other pet parents.

took my cat to creature comforts what a place.! great service and a wonderful team to look after your pets.
great job guys.
Great place to go.

Everything went perfectly. It is by far the best veterinary clinic I have ever been to. The facilities are very new and modern, and the staff are extremely friendly, both to me and to my dog. The app they have runs really well. 100% recommeded.
The team here are so incredibly lovely and take care of my puppy really well. They are always so smiley and great with everything they do ! I appreciate their work.

Always most welcoming and friendly reception and pet treatment. Moreover way cheaper than other vets in the area, I have visited quite a few vets but this one is definitely the top, can’t recommend enough!⭐️

My cat usually shakes with fear at the vet, but at Creature Comforts Chelsea she’s completely relaxed — she actually loves everyone there! The whole team are so warm and welcoming, and the vets genuinely care about the animals they see. You can really tell they go above and beyond to make every visit a positive experience. I couldn’t recommend them more!

My dog Albert has always hated vets, but he LOVES Creature Comforts in Chelsea! The team are so nice and welcoming, from the moment you walk into the practice you feel at home. They even let Albert choose his treat from the Halloween basket. Lovely friendly team, and amazing vets that make you feel so comfortable and safe. I’m so happy I found this practice
Great vet. Easy to get an appointment. Super friendly and a really nice atmosphere in the surgery.

The best vet experience we’ve ever had. Our dog is usually very frightened of the vet, but all of the doctors and staff here are so good with him and the level of service both in clinic and through the messaging app are fantastic. Thanks for taking such great care of our boy!
Excellent services, everyone make you feel so welcome ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

We recently joined Creature Comforts Chelsea, and the service has been exceptional. Our Cavapoo, Ziggy, absolutely loves the team — they always make such a fuss of him! Communication is excellent, and the app makes it so easy to manage his health and access vets on demand.

Ziggy recently had a teeth scale and polish. We were kept updated throughout the procedure.
